This adverse event summary is based on the structured quality records for the period listed as 2026-Q1.

For measure CLABSI-01, “Central line-associated bloodstream infection rate,” the reported unit is per 1,000 line-days. The numerator is 69, the denominator is 887, and exclusions are 37. The reported rate is 74.12 per 1,000 line-days. The event_dates field lists 2026-01-26, 2026-04-14, 2026-06-26, 2026-08-07, and 2026-11-02.

For measure SEP-B1, “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours,” the reported unit is percent. The numerator is 115, the denominator is 535, and exclusions are 41. The reported rate is 23.28 percent. The event_dates field lists 2026-02-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-28, and 2026-10-19.

For measure HAPI-02, “Hospital-acquired pressure injury rate,” the reported unit is percent. The numerator is 225, the denominator is 1274, and exclusions are 32. The reported rate is 18.12 percent. The event_dates field lists 2026-01-19, 2026-05-17, 2026-05-19, 2026-06-27, and 2026-12-07.

Across the submitted records, the measures address central line-associated bloodstream infection, sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours, and hospital-acquired pressure injury. Each record includes a numerator, denominator, exclusions, rate, unit, period, and event_dates field. No additional stratification, patient-level detail, location, severity, harm category, preventability assessment, or corrective action information is included in the supplied records.
